Lower on the page, donc splitting unique is written with unique doubly underlined. See crops/136_scan078_L331.jpg and crops/136_scan078_L331_unique.jpg.
rows.note: L331.R1: the disputed projectivity/splitting sentence is not a transcription error; the original agrees with the ink and supplies no degreewise qualifier. Preserve it. The row distinguishes splittings in individual simplicial degrees from a compatible simplicial splitting; that is a mathematical refinement of the statement, not text to insert. The page explicitly treats p=q=1 and writes unique; no independent proof of uniqueness or general existence is claimed. The second crop has original box [188,1418,1260,1568].
